purpose: Customer-facing OTP login surface used before final order confirmation and from the profile/account entry point.
uiRules: Do not reuse admin form controls for this customer login screen; the login card must use customer-login-input and customer CTA styling.
Inputs must remain dark wine/gold in normal, focused, and browser autofill states.
The primary login button must render as a premium SHRESTA customer CTA with a distinct LogIn icon, centered label, right arrow affordance, and gold focus ring.
The non-production test-login helper is allowed only in non-production/UAT-configured builds, must stay visually secondary, and must not use internal labels such as local/UAT in visible copy.
businessRules: Login posts to /api/customer-login and stores the backend session token only in an HTTP-only cookie.
Cart state must remain browser-preserved when navigating to login and returning to checkout/account.
Error messages shown in the error box are always user-readable strings from submitCustomerLogin result.message — never raw API codes or internal exception strings.
submitCustomerLogin handles the toShrestaUserMessage translation at the route layer; the component only renders whatever message it receives.
